text: Sources: MER_VIS_local_geometry_manifest.csv; MER_VIS_report_summary.json and MER_VIS_report_verification.json in D:/Dropbox/Public Documents/UCLAN/MSc Research/Euclid/MER_VIS_galaxy_reports/all_2777; completed PA and inclination comparison statistics from the revised fitting report. Run completed October 2026. The unflagged comparison includes 546 fits, including 19 partial cutouts, and differs from the 527 NoQI group. Codex fits Photutils isophotes, converts their pixel major-axis vectors using the local FITS WCS, and calculates degrees(atan2(East, North)) modulo 180. It uses axial means in selected disc and bar radial ranges. These are observed sky PAs before deprojection. North towards East is counterclockwise on a North-up East-left display, clockwise if East is right. Euclid documents raw POSITION_ANGLE as CCW from image x (SExtractor THETA_IMAGE), not necessarily celestial East. Our +90 adjustment follows the WCS conversion. For North-up East-left images, sky PA = (CCW image angle from +x +90) modulo180. This reference change is ALREADY included in the original WCS conversion. The adopted ADDITIONAL +90 follows that conversion and cannot be explained by counting the same reference change again. The observed offset is consistent with POSITION_ANGLE being referenced to the detection image y-axis rather than the documented x-axis, assuming the same rotation sense and major-axis definition. Interpreting a y-referenced value as x-referenced introduces a quarter-turn, cancelled by the additional 90-degree adjustment modulo180. This is a plausible explanation, not a confirmed documentation or pipeline error. The 2777 local North offsets have median absolute 0.141 degrees and maximum 0.604 degrees. No additional thumbnail rotation is applied. We adopt the correction without asserting an official Euclid North/East reference change. Euclid source: https://euclid.esac.esa.int/dr/q1/dpdd/merdpd/dpcards/mer_finalcatalog.html#mer-main-catalog-fits. Inclinations assume a circular thin disc, q0=0. No separate disc-component b/a values are populated. These are consistency checks, not independent true outer-disc measurements.
